s05131.summary: Adrian waits by a pallet in the cold, empty warehouse
Kestrel arrives late and Adrian scolds them
Adrian asks for the package; Kestrel demands who sold their name
Ignoring his phone, Adrian denies anyone sold them out
Adrian steps forward begging for the package; Kestrel demands the name
Adrian opens his coat and a metal box clicks onto the floor

s05118_0.summary: Aiden, Sasha and Marlon break into the dark vet clinic
A squeaky toy wakes the beagle, which yawns and sleeps again
Aiden explains the safe holds Okafor's ring with a faked backstory
Marlon calls it returning to the universe and Sasha mocks the plan
Aiden hushes them and they slip into the office

s05034.summary: Four strangers wait out their laundry, trading idle remarks
Priya notices a man lingering by the bins; Oswald shrugs it off
A tall man in a slicker brings in a heavy, still bag
The bag shifts and every washer stops at once

s05150_3.summary: Priya calmly tells Nell she found everything
Toby offers to fix the hall light and Priya says leave it

s05030.summary: Teo works the sorting belt while a woman watches from the stairs
The woman tells Teo the belt doesn't care, only whether he flinches
Hands shaking, Teo keeps scanning parcels anyway
Teo asks her name; she says Marguerite and orders the next scan
